# AI Solution Architecture and Platform Design

> Turn requirements into tested scenarios, costed options and recorded decisions, then design the shared AI platform many teams build on. SDAIA Academy course AE-402, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,832 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: From requirements to architecture](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day1.md): Drivers, scenarios with numbers, classified flows and views as code for Muyassir; sessions: The architect's loop for AI systems, Quality attributes with numbers, Regulation as a design constraint, Views as code; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day1.html; about 5,160 tokens
- [Day 2: Options and decisions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day2.md): Patterns, three options costed over three years, lock-in and a decision log; sessions: Patterns and when each fits, Total cost over three years, Lock-in and exit, Decision records; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day2.html; about 5,013 tokens
- [Day 3: The shared platform](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day3.md): Asas as a product: demand, admission, a gateway that refuses, tenancy and showback; sessions: The platform is a product, Catalogue, admission and the gateway, Tenancy and shared capacity, Who pays for which tokens; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day3.html; about 4,246 tokens
- [Day 4: Reference designs and reviews](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day4.md): A golden path, fitness checks, a structured review and a deviation decided on one page; sessions: Golden paths, Fitness functions, Structured architecture review, Deviations and sponsors; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/day4.html; about 4,921 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/capstone.md): Ten minutes of architecture and eight of questions, with one classification or forecast changed by the panel; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/slides/capstone.html; about 981 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Drivers, constraints and stakeholders](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D1_1_drivers.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Five measurable scenarios](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D1_2_scenarios.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Classified flows and placement](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D1_3_data_flows.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Views as code and a request budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D1_4_views_budget.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Patterns and a non-generative baseline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D2_1_patterns.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Three options over three years](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D2_2_three_year_cost.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Exit cost, weights and two requirements](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D2_3_exit_cost.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Two decision records and a challenge](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D2_4_decision_records.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: A demand matrix from six months of usage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D3_1_demand_matrix.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Model admission and a gateway that refuses](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D3_2_admission_gateway.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Three incidents, two tenancy models](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D3_3_tenancy.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A showback that reconciles](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D3_4_showback.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: A golden path from the permits team's service](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D4_1_golden_path.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Two fitness checks over designs as data](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D4_2_fitness_checks.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: A structured review of Kashif's design](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D4_3_review.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: A deviation request, decided and explained on one page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-402/labs/D4_4_deviation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
